annotations.title: What this workspace learned about ads

description:
[read-only] The insights library: finished experiments and deep-dive verdicts confirmed across runs (worked / did not work), each deep-dive one with its evidence and report link. Pass `platform` to also get the do/avoid suggestions for a new campaign there; `source` filters to experiment or deep_dive. Read only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/learned-insights.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

platform.description: A network (facebook, instagram, tiktok...). Adds the do/avoid suggestions for a new campaign there.
